title: Android TV Focus, D-pad Navigation, and Media Quality Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies android tv focus, d-pad navigation, and media quality?
options: Design the focus graph and media lifecycle explicitly, then test every journey without touch across content and error changes.
questions.answer: Design the focus graph and media lifecycle explicitly, then test every journey without touch across content and error changes.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: If all TV controls are clickable, users can necessarily reach them with a D-pad.
questions.explanation: Reordering a loaded content rail without stable identity or focus restoration can strand focus or jump the user to an unrelated item.

questions.prompt: What must survive asynchronous TV list updates?
questions.answer: Stable item identity and an intentional focus restoration target so remote navigation remains predictable.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
